frases: July 8, 1947. 6:17 PM. The FBI office in Dallas sends an urgent teletype to the Director.
The Eighth Air Force reports an object purporting to be a flying disc, recovered near Roswell, New Mexico.
Hexagonal in shape. Hanging from a balloon about twenty feet wide.
It looks like a weather balloon with a radar reflector. But Wright Field did not confirm that.
It is flown to Wright Field by special plane, while the press tries to break the story.
The last line says: no further investigation being conducted.
